$comment: Every environment variable verifier-plus reads. A deployment sets the ones marked for it; app/lib/settings.contract.test.ts checks this file against app/lib/settings.ts. 'required' is 'always', 'never', or the condition under which the setting must be set. 'readBy' is 'app' (app/lib/settings.ts) or 'next' (the Next.js standalone server). 'docker' and 'lambda' say who sets it there: 'you' (the operator), 'image' (the Dockerfile), 'run.sh' (dist/lambda/run.sh), 'template' (the deployment's template), 'runtime' (AWS Lambda itself), or 'unused'.

settings.name: CREDENTIAL_STORE
settings.purpose: Where shared credentials are kept. memory keeps them in the process and loses them on restart (local development and tests only).

settings.name: CREDENTIAL_TTL_DAYS
settings.values: a positive whole number of days
settings.purpose: How long a shared credential stays viewable after it is shared.

settings.name: CREDENTIAL_TABLE
settings.purpose: The table shared credentials are kept in. Its key is the string attribute id, and its TTL attribute is expiresAt.

settings.name: DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT
settings.purpose: Only for DynamoDB Local, such as http://localhost:8000. Unset to reach AWS.

settings.name: DB_URI
settings.required: when CREDENTIAL_STORE=mongodb, unless DB_HOST is set
settings.values: a mongodb:// or mongodb+srv:// connection string
settings.purpose: The MongoDB connection string, used as given. Set this or DB_HOST, not both.

settings.name: DB_HOST
settings.required: when CREDENTIAL_STORE=mongodb, unless DB_URI is set
settings.purpose: The 2.x way to connect: the app builds mongodb+srv://DB_USER:DB_PASS@DB_HOST.

settings.name: DB_NAME
settings.purpose: The database shared credentials are kept in.

settings.name: DB_COLLECTION
settings.purpose: The collection shared credentials are kept in.

settings.name: EXCHANGES
settings.purpose: Whether the landing page offers to request credentials from the Learner Credential Wallet. Exchanges live in process memory, so on is refused on Lambda.

settings.name: EXCHANGE_SERVER_URL
settings.values: an absolute http or https URL
settings.default: the address the browser used to reach the page
settings.purpose: Where wallets reach the exchange. Read only when EXCHANGES=on.

settings.name: AWS_REGION
settings.purpose: The region of CREDENTIAL_TABLE. Provided by the runtime on Lambda; set it yourself only to run the dynamodb store elsewhere.

settings.name: AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME
settings.purpose: Provided by the runtime. Its presence tells the app it is on Lambda, where EXCHANGES=on is refused.

settings.name: PORT
settings.purpose: The port the server listens on. On Lambda, the port the Web Adapter forwards to.

settings.name: HOSTNAME
settings.purpose: The interface the server listens on.
